repair.problem: Proof gates can fail on temporary observations even when the authoritative control-plane state is valid, creating stale-state assertions, false reds, redundant reruns, and downstream bottlenecks.
repair.root_cause: Existing proof components know how to classify change scope, WAIT states, failures, proof reuse, and frozen-registry reconciliation, but there is no single contract that says which stable evidence is authoritative for each current state and which transient observations must not become blocking truth.
repair.patch: Add a read-only state-aware proof contract that recognizes READY, WAIT, RECONCILING, FAILED, and BLOCKED as explicit states; binds proof identity only to stable state evidence; ignores transient poll/timestamp/selector noise; requires event-driven WAIT identity; requires reconciliation state-hash progress; and fails closed on contradictions or unknown states.
